versions.changelog:
Initial release of Jarvis—Chief of AI Staff for OpenClaw (v1.0.0):

- Deploy a local-first, on-premise AI executive assistant optimized for Dell Pro Max GB10 (NVIDIA DGX Spark) edge devices.
- Easy setup instructions for persona bootstrapping, LLM backend configuration (Ollama/LM Studio), and security hardening.
- Supports advanced work automation: email/calendar triage, project management, research, competitive intelligence, and system monitoring.
- Fully detailed installation and verification process tailored for enterprise/data-sovereign operations.
- Designed for OpenClaw, requires Linux, Docker, and local LLM (Ollama or LM Studio).
